# DATASET — {Run title} experiments

**ID**: `cpt-{system}-dataset-{slug}`

## Table of Contents

<!-- generated by `cfs toc` -->

<!-- Every experiment acquired during one agent run, in acquisition order. One unit of analysis = one experiment. Keep only headings and {placeholder} text in this file. -->

## 1. Origin and Source

{Origin on the first line: `ground-truth`, `simulator`, or `mixed` (then origin is given per batch in Acquisition). For ground truth: instrument, lab or facility, operator, calibration state. For a simulator: MCP server and simulate tool name, model config file, tool contract version, simulator commit; the true system is hidden inside it and nothing here may assume it.}

## 2. Apparatus

{Copied from the simulator contract or the instrument documentation, never from memory: source quantities; sample or reactor size and the normalisation the apparatus applies; observable(s); sampling points and window; noise model, σ, and whether it is seeded; allowed range per condition.}

## 3. Units of Analysis

{One unit = one experiment: one condition vector plus the observable trajectory it returned. Naming convention for experiment names. Count of units so far and the batches they came in.}

## 4. Units of Measure

{Every quantity with its unit and where that unit comes from. This table is what the PLAN concordance is checked against. Same quantity in a different unit elsewhere → the conversion factor is written here.}

| Quantity | Unit | Source of the unit | Note |
|----------|------|--------------------|------|
| {observable} | {…} | {contract / instrument manual} | {…} |
| {condition 1} | {…} | {…} | {proposed unit vs effective unit, if they differ} |
| {measurement axis} | {…} | {…} | {offset, if any} |

## 5. Axes

{Every axis declared MEASUREMENT or SYNTHESIS. Procedures act along the MEASUREMENT axis inside one unit; comparisons across units run along SYNTHESIS axes. The explored range is what the acquired units actually cover; an applicability claim in a RUN may not exceed it.}

| Axis | Kind | Allowed range | Explored range | Notes |
|------|------|---------------|----------------|-------|
| {measurement axis, e.g. time} | MEASUREMENT | {window, number of points} | same | identical for every unit; {no point at the origin, if so} |
| {condition 1} | SYNTHESIS | {range} | {min–max over acquired units} | one value per unit |
| {condition 2} | SYNTHESIS | {range} | {…} | one value per unit |
| {condition that can drive the system inert} | SYNTHESIS | {range} | {…} | beyond {threshold} the trajectory is flat and carries no information about the dynamics |

## 6. Acquisition

{Batches in the order they were run. 1 batch = 1 simulate call = {N} experiments. Justification and design method are copied from the agent's pre-call plan, written BEFORE the call, never reconstructed afterwards. Justification is one of `variance → <parameter>`, `information → <open pair of COMPARISON id, hypothesis IDs>`, `boundary → <assumption or range>` per the PLAN design policy. Design method is the design tool with its criterion and seed, or `manual: <reason the tool was not used>`. For a ground-truth batch, the preview column names the simulator batch or RUN that previewed the same conditions, or states why there was none. Actual duration is compared to the cost confirmed in the PLAN.}

| Batch | Phase | Origin | Experiments | Justification (type → target) | Design method | Simulator preview | Actual duration | Approved by |
|-------|-------|--------|-------------|-------------------------------|---------------|-------------------|-----------------|-------------|
| 1 | PRE-1 | simulator | {exp names} | {per experiment, e.g. `information → cpt-{system}-comparison-c1 pair A/B, hypothesis cpt-{system}-hypothesis-binding-order`} | {tool, criterion, seed} or `manual: {reason}` | n/a | {…} | {person, date} |
| {…} | {…} | ground-truth | {…} | {…} | {…} | {batch or RUN id} | {…} | {…} |

## 7. Normalisation

{Exactly how the apparatus maps proposed conditions to effective conditions (e.g. volumes to concentrations as stock × volume / total), any offset applied to the measurement axis, and the units everything is stored in. State explicitly that nothing else is transformed.}

## 8. Known Defects

{Units whose trajectory never leaves its starting value ± 2σ: they do not constrain the dynamics. Units lost to a tool or instrument failure: the phase failed, the batch is absent, say which. Repeated conditions differ by noise when the simulator is unseeded. Batches whose actual duration or cost departed materially from the PLAN figure.}

## 9. Provenance

{Agent database run id; phase numbers and step ids holding the raw observations; for ground truth, the raw instrument files; exported conditions and measurements files with checksums.}
